name: Radiant ring expansion
what: A glowing ring with a word in the middle pops in on a dark ground; the camera drifts and three small labelled rings are born from its rim one after another and fly out in arcs; then the view pulls back and the three settle around the big ring.
origin: MotionLab's own build in the Editorial warm look (2026-10)
motion: f1-f15: the centre ring pops in (1.1x overshoot, blurred); f26-f62 the ring drifts up then down while a small ring is born at f26 (lower left) and flies out in an arc; f57 a second one (upper left), f86 a third (right); f80-f92 the first two fly off to the left edge and f100-f118 back; f104-f118 the camera pulls back to 0.72x (blurred) and the three settle around the big ring; they float a few pixels to f209.
